# AVM Smart

> AVM Smart is a digital solutions company providing website development, mobile app development, custom software, SEO and technology solutions for businesses.

## Company Information
- Primary Name: AVM Smart
- Alternate Name: AVM Smart Solutions
- Domain: https://www.avmsmart.in/
- Tagline: Digital Solutions for Real Business Growth

## About AVM Smart
AVM Smart is a full-service technology consulting and digital development company based in Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, India. We engineer high-performance websites, enterprise mobile applications, custom web portals, and scalable cloud software solutions that help businesses work smarter and accelerate growth.

## Core Services
1. Website Development: Custom responsive corporate websites, Next.js web applications, and landing pages.
2. Mobile App Development: Native & cross-platform Android and iOS applications built with modern frameworks.
3. Custom Software Development: Tailored business management systems, e-commerce platforms, and CRM portals.
4. Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Technical SEO, local search optimization, content strategy, and page speed performance tuning.
5. Digital Solutions & IT Consulting: Enterprise architecture, cloud deployment, DevOps, and UI/UX design.
